small_guidance: Enable allow_tf32=True in tl.dot (GPT-2 fp32 weights tolerate TF32 within atol) to roughly double tensor-core throughput on the 4090. Trim the autotune space to the 2-3 configs that actually win for M=8192,K=768,N=768/2304/3072/50257 (e.g. BLOCK_M=128,BLOCK_N=128,BLOCK_K=32,num_warps=4,stages=4) to cut first-call autotune overhead. Also fuse the bias add and (for the c_attn split) avoid the .view round-trip by writing directly to a 3D output.
large_guidance: Redesign around persistent / split-K GEMMs and op fusion: (1) fuse the QKV projection by treating c_attn as one large GEMM that already writes into the Q/K/V layout the attention expects, (2) write a fused GEMM+GELU kernel for the MLP fc layer and a fused GEMM+residual+LayerNorm-input kernel for c_proj, (3) replace softmax/attention with a Triton flash-attention kernel, since after Linear replacement the attention softmax/matmuls become the next bottleneck. Also implement the final lm_head (768x50257) as a dedicated tall-skinny GEMM kernel tuned for that shape rather than the generic autotuned one.
